title: Compile traceable delivery
summary: Turn hydrated outcome requirements into distinct OpenSpec artifacts and an evidence ledger.

requirements.title: Traceable delivery
requirements.observableBehavior: Operators can query every task from requirement through remote and delivery evidence.
decisions: Keep proposed and implemented state distinct.
Do not treat task checkboxes as delivery evidence.

scenarios.title: Evidence closes the trace
scenarios.when: All required delivery evidence is observed

tasks.title: Implement the trace compiler
acceptanceCriteria: Distinct proposal, design, specification, and task artifacts are emitted
The ledger remains incomplete until integrated remote evidence exists

expectedEvidence.description: Tested commit is observed on remote main
